fusions.name: Folded Dart
fusions.desc: Glides a sharp fold into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fluttering Verdict
fusions.desc: Strikes for 12 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Weightless Drift
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Written in Flight
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
